verses.sloka: ततः स मध्यंगतमंशुमन्तं ।ज्योत्स्नावितानम् महदुद्वमन्तम् ।ददर्श धीमान् दिवि भानुमन्तम् ।गोष्ठे वृषं मत्तमिव भ्रामन्तम् ॥५-५-१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa madhyaṁgatamaṁśumantaṁ ।jyotsnāvitānam mahadudvamantam ।dadarśa dhīmān divi bhānumantam ।goṣṭhe vṛṣaṁ mattamiva bhrāmantam ॥5-5-1॥

translations.english: Then intelligent Hanuman observed the Moon in the central part of the sky spreading a canopy of his luminescence like the Sun, and looking like an intoxicated mighty (white) bull moving in a stable.

verses.sloka: लोकस्य पापानि विनाशयन्तम् ।महोदधिं चापि समेधयन्तम् ।भूतानि सर्वाणि विराजयन्तम् ।ददर्श शीताम्शुमथाभियान्तम् ॥५-५-२॥
verses.transliteration: lokasya pāpāni vināśayantam ।mahodadhiṁ cāpi samedhayantam ।bhūtāni sarvāṇi virājayantam ।dadarśa śītāmśumathābhiyāntam ॥5-5-2॥

translations.english: While moving forward, Hanuman saw the Moon spreading his light, thereby warding off the agony of all creatures, causing the swelling of the ocean and illuminating the earth as well as the sky.

verses.sloka: या भाति  लक्ष्मीर्भुवि मन्दरस्था ।तथा प्रदोषेषु च सागरस्था ।तथैव तोयेषु च पुष्करस्था ।रराज सा चारुनिशाकरस्था ॥५-५-३॥
verses.transliteration: yā bhāti  lakṣmīrbhuvi mandarasthā ।tathā pradoṣeṣu ca sāgarasthā ।tathaiva toyeṣu ca puṣkarasthā ।rarāja sā cāruniśākarasthā ॥5-5-3॥

translations.english: 'The same splendour on the Mandara mountain on earth, which glows at dusk lay on the ocean is there, on lotuses in the lakes and on the beautiful Moon also.

verses.sloka: हम्सो यथा राजतपञ्जरसथः ।सिम्हो यथा मन्दरकन्दरस्थः ।वीरो यथा गर्वितकुञ्जरस्थ ।श्चन्द्रो विबभ्राज तथामभरस्थः ॥५-५-४॥
verses.transliteration: hamso yathā rājatapañjarasathaḥ ।simho yathā mandarakandarasthaḥ ।vīro yathā garvitakuñjarastha ।ścandro vibabhrāja tathāmabharasthaḥ ॥5-5-4॥

translations.english: 'Like a swan in a cage of silver, like a lion in a cave of Mandara mountain, like a hero on a proud, intoxicated elephant, the Moon shone in the sky.

verses.sloka: स्थितह् ककुद्मानिव तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो ।महाचलः श्वेत इवोच्चशृङ्गः ।हस्तीव जाम्बूनदबद्धश्^इङ्गो ।रराज चन्द्रह् परिपूर्णशृङ्गः ॥५-५-५॥
verses.transliteration: sthitah kakudmāniva tīkṣṇaśṛṅgo ।mahācalaḥ śveta ivoccaśṛṅgaḥ ।hastīva jāmbūnadabaddhaś^iṅgo ।rarāja candrah paripūrṇaśṛṅgaḥ ॥5-5-5॥

translations.english: The fullmoon with its hornlike spot shone like a bull with sharp horns, like the white Himalayan mountain with its lofty peaks, and like an elephant with gold plated tusks

verses.sloka: विनष्टशीताम्बुतुषारपङ्को ।महाग्रहग्राहविनष्टपङ्कः ।प्रकाशलक्ष्म्याश्रयनिर्मलाङ्को ।रराज चन्द्रो भगवान् शशाङ्कः ॥५-५-६॥
verses.transliteration: vinaṣṭaśītāmbutuṣārapaṅko ।mahāgrahagrāhavinaṣṭapaṅkaḥ ।prakāśalakṣmyāśrayanirmalāṅko ।rarāja candro bhagavān śaśāṅkaḥ ॥5-5-6॥

translations.english: With the Sun, the great planet (star), destroying the frost that forms the dew, the Moon with its stain shone with graceful radiance.
translations.hindi: तम सीत जल अरु तुहिन को रवि किरन कीनो नास है । निरमल कलंकहु तेज सों श्रति ससि करत परकास है

verses.sloka: शीलातलम् प्राप्य यथा मृगेन्द्रो ।महारणम् प्राप्य यथा गजेन्द्रह् ।राज्यम् समासाद्य यथा नरेन्द्र ।स्तथाप्रकाशो विरराज चन्द्रः ॥५-५-७॥
verses.transliteration: śīlātalam prāpya yathā mṛgendro ।mahāraṇam prāpya yathā gajendrah ।rājyam samāsādya yathā narendra ।stathāprakāśo virarāja candraḥ ॥5-5-7॥

translations.english: The Moon shone bright like a lion mounted on a rock, like a lordly elephant in a deep forest, like a king on attaining the kingdom.

verses.sloka: प्रकाशचन्द्रोदयनष्टदोषः ।प्रवृत्तरक्षः पिशिताशदोषः ।रामाभिरामेरितचित्तदोषः ।स्वर्गप्रकाशो भगवान् प्रदोषः ॥५-५-८॥
verses.transliteration: prakāśacandrodayanaṣṭadoṣaḥ ।pravṛttarakṣaḥ piśitāśadoṣaḥ ।rāmābhirāmeritacittadoṣaḥ ।svargaprakāśo bhagavān pradoṣaḥ ॥5-5-8॥

translations.english: At the time of moonrise, the darkness of dusk is dispelled, the dark deeds of cannibals disappear, the natural instinct for love returns to women as the radiance of the Moon spreads everywhere like in heaven.
translations.hindi: ससि तेज तम दुरि बढ्यो श्रामिढ-भखन रजनीचरन को । रमनी-प्रनय-कलहहिं दुराइ प्रदोस है सुखकरन को

verses.sloka: तन्त्रीस्वनाह् कर्णसुखाः प्रवृत्ताः ।स्वपन्ति नार्यः पतिभिः सुवृत्ताः ।नक्तम्चराश्चापि तथा प्रवृत्ता ।विहर्तुमत्यद्भुतरौद्रवृत्ताः ॥५-५-९॥
verses.transliteration: tantrīsvanāh karṇasukhāḥ pravṛttāḥ ।svapanti nāryaḥ patibhiḥ suvṛttāḥ ।naktamcarāścāpi tathā pravṛttā ।vihartumatyadbhutaraudravṛttāḥ ॥5-5-9॥

translations.english: Pleasing sounds of string instruments had begun to be heard. Chaste women were found asleep with their husbands.The nightrangers had begun their strange (evil and cruel) deeds exhibiting their anger.

verses.sloka: मत्तप्रमत्तानि समाकुलानि ।तथाश्वभद्रासनसम्कुलानि ।वीरः श्रिया चापि समाकुलानि ।ददर्श धीमान् स कपिः कुलानि ॥५-५-१०॥
verses.transliteration: mattapramattāni samākulāni ।tathāśvabhadrāsanasamkulāni ।vīraḥ śriyā cāpi samākulāni ।dadarśa dhīmān sa kapiḥ kulāni ॥5-5-10॥

translations.english: Intelligent Hanuman, the great warrior, observed there in the prosperous mansions, demons proud of their wealth, highly intoxicated and dull, their houses full of horsedrawn chariots with comfortable seats.

verses.sloka: परस्परं चाधिकमाक्षिपन्ति ।भुआम्श्च पीनानधिनिक्षिपन्ति ।मत्तप्रलापानधिकम् क्षिपन्ति ।मत्तानि चान्योन्यमधिक्षिपन्ति ॥५-५-११॥
verses.transliteration: parasparaṁ cādhikamākṣipanti ।bhuāmśca pīnānadhinikṣipanti ।mattapralāpānadhikam kṣipanti ।mattāni cānyonyamadhikṣipanti ॥5-5-11॥

translations.english: The intoxicated demons were quarrelling, ridiculing one another bitterly and wildly throwing their stout arms on one another, indulging in incoherent talk, uttering vulgar words.

verses.sloka: रक्षाम्सि वक्षाम्सि च विक्षिपन्ति ।गात्राणि कान्तासु च विक्षिपन्ति ।रूपाअणि चित्राणि च विक्षिपन्ति ।दृढानि चापानि च विक्षिपन्ति ॥५-५-१२॥
verses.transliteration: rakṣāmsi vakṣāmsi ca vikṣipanti ।gātrāṇi kāntāsu ca vikṣipanti ।rūpāaṇi citrāṇi ca vikṣipanti ।dṛḍhāni cāpāni ca vikṣipanti ॥5-5-12॥

translations.english: The demons were seen expanding their chests sportively and caressing their wives by placing their limbs on them. They were assuming wonderful forms, and drawing their bows up to their ears.

verses.sloka: ददर्श कान्ताश्च समालभन्त्य ।स्तथा परास्तत्र पुनः स्वपन्त्यः ।सुरूपवक्त्राश्च तथा हसन्त्यः ।क्रुद्धाः पराश्चपि विनिःश्वसन्त्यः ॥५-५-१३॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśa kāntāśca samālabhantya ।stathā parāstatra punaḥ svapantyaḥ ।surūpavaktrāśca tathā hasantyaḥ ।kruddhāḥ parāścapi viniḥśvasantyaḥ ॥5-5-13॥

translations.english: He even saw women collected there, their limbs smeared with unguents on their bodies, like wise women with beautiful countenances laughing at others, some sleeping, and others hissing (sighing) like angry serpents.

verses.sloka: महागजैश्चापि तथा नदद्भिः ।सुपूजितैश्चापि तथा सुसद्भिः ।रराज वीरैश्च विनिःश्वसद्भि ।र्ह्रदो भुजङ्गैरिव निःश्वसद्भिः ॥५-५-१४॥
verses.transliteration: mahāgajaiścāpi tathā nadadbhiḥ ।supūjitaiścāpi tathā susadbhiḥ ।rarāja vīraiśca viniḥśvasadbhi ।rhrado bhujaṅgairiva niḥśvasadbhiḥ ॥5-5-14॥

translations.english: There were huge elephants trumpeting, respected people, warriors sighing for the lack of enemies (to vanquish). It had a lake infested with hissing snakes.

verses.sloka: बुद्धिप्रधानान् रुचिराभिधानान् ।सम्श्रद्दधानान् जगतः प्रधानान् ।नानाविधानान् रुचिराभिधानान् ।ददर्श तस्याम् पुरि यातुधानान् ॥५-५-१५॥
verses.transliteration: buddhipradhānān rucirābhidhānān ।samśraddadhānān jagataḥ pradhānān ।nānāvidhānān rucirābhidhānān ।dadarśa tasyām puri yātudhānān ॥5-5-15॥

translations.english: He saw there in the city of Lanka, demons, who were intellectuals, pleasing in words, with faith in religion, preeminent heroes of the world of different kinds, followers of good practices and with lovely names.

verses.sloka: ननन्द दृष्ट्वा स च तान् सुरूपा ।न्नानागुणानात्मगुणानुरूपान् ।विद्योतमानान्स तदानुरूपान् ।ददर्श काम्श्चिच्च पुनर्विरूपान् ॥५-५-१६॥
verses.transliteration: nananda dṛṣṭvā sa ca tān surūpā ।nnānāguṇānātmaguṇānurūpān ।vidyotamānānsa tadānurūpān ।dadarśa kāmścicca punarvirūpān ॥5-5-16॥

translations.english: He rejoiced to see the handsome demons radiant with forms commensurate with their virtues. He also saw some ugly figures, their traits in conformity to their forms.

verses.sloka: ततो वरार्हः सुविशुद्धभावा ।स्तेषाम् स्त्रियस्तत्र महानुभावाह् ।प्रियेषु पानेषु च सक्तभावा ।ददर्श ताराइव सुप्रभावाः ॥५-५-१७॥
verses.transliteration: tato varārhaḥ suviśuddhabhāvā ।steṣām striyastatra mahānubhāvāh ।priyeṣu pāneṣu ca saktabhāvā ।dadarśa tārāiva suprabhāvāḥ ॥5-5-17॥

translations.english: There he saw demonesses adorned with choicest ornaments, their minds attached faithfully to their husbands and bottles of wine. Some of the wives of the demons, however, looked gentle and bright like stars.

verses.sloka: श्रिया ज्वलन्तीस्त्रपयोगूढा ।निशीथकाले रमणोपगूढाः ।ददर्श काश्चित्प्रमदोपगूढा ।यथा विहङ्गाः कुसुमोपगूढाः ॥५-५-१८॥
verses.transliteration: śriyā jvalantīstrapayogūḍhā ।niśīthakāle ramaṇopagūḍhāḥ ।dadarśa kāścitpramadopagūḍhā ।yathā vihaṅgāḥ kusumopagūḍhāḥ ॥5-5-18॥

translations.english: There he saw cheerful demonesses shining brightly, abashed by the embrace of their beloveds during the night. He also saw those sporting with their beloveds freely and looking like birds embracing flowers.

verses.sloka: अन्याः पुनर्हर्म्यतलोपविष्टा ।स्तत्र प्रियाङ्केषु सुखोपविष्टाः ।भर्तुः प्रिया धर्मपरा निविष्टा ।ददर्श  धीमान् मदनाभिविष्टाः ॥५-५-१९॥
verses.transliteration: anyāḥ punarharmyatalopaviṣṭā ।statra priyāṅkeṣu sukhopaviṣṭāḥ ।bhartuḥ priyā dharmaparā niviṣṭā ।dadarśa  dhīmān madanābhiviṣṭāḥ ॥5-5-19॥

translations.english: Intelligent Hanuman saw demonesses seated happily on the laps of their beloved ones on the terraces of the mansions, exhibiting their attachment to one another, overwhelmed with sexual pleasure.

verses.sloka: अप्रावृताः काञ्चनराजिवर्णाः ।काश्चित्परार्थ्यास्तपनीयवर्णाः ।पुनश्च काश्चिच्छशलक्ष्मवर्णाः ।कान्तप्रहीणारुचिराङ्गवर्णाः ॥५-५-२०॥
verses.transliteration: aprāvṛtāḥ kāñcanarājivarṇāḥ ।kāścitparārthyāstapanīyavarṇāḥ ।punaśca kāścicchaśalakṣmavarṇāḥ ।kāntaprahīṇārucirāṅgavarṇāḥ ॥5-5-20॥

translations.english: Ogresses without veil, some altruistic, some separated from their husbands looked pale like the Moon, though possessed of polished gold complexion.

verses.sloka: ततह् प्रियान् प्राप्य मनोभिरामान् ।सुप्रीतियुक्ताः सुमनोभिरामाः ।गृहेषु हृष्टाः परमाभिरामाः ।हरिप्रवीरः स ददर्श रामाः ॥५-५-२१॥
verses.transliteration: tatah priyān prāpya manobhirāmān ।suprītiyuktāḥ sumanobhirāmāḥ ।gṛheṣu hṛṣṭāḥ paramābhirāmāḥ ।haripravīraḥ sa dadarśa rāmāḥ ॥5-5-21॥

translations.english: That heroic monkey saw ogresses delighted in the happy company of their loved ones who have joined them, ecstatic wives in the houses.

verses.sloka: चन्द्रप्रकाशाश्च हि वक्त्रमाला ।वक्राक्षिपक्ष्माश्च सुनेत्रमालाः ।विभूषाणानाम् च ददर्श मालाः ।शतह्रदानामिव चारुमालाः ॥५-५-२२॥
verses.transliteration: candraprakāśāśca hi vaktramālā ।vakrākṣipakṣmāśca sunetramālāḥ ।vibhūṣāṇānām ca dadarśa mālāḥ ।śatahradānāmiva cārumālāḥ ॥5-5-22॥

translations.english: He saw rows of faces of shedemons shining like moonlight with sidelong glances and graceful eyelashes wearing ornaments resembling charmimg flashes of lightning.

verses.sloka: न त्वेव सीताम् परमाभिजाताम् ।पथि स्थिते राजकुले प्रजाताम् ।लताम् प्रपुल्लामिव साधु जाताम् ।ददर्श तन्वीम् मनसाभिजाताम् ॥५-५-२३॥
verses.transliteration: na tveva sītām paramābhijātām ।pathi sthite rājakule prajātām ।latām prapullāmiva sādhu jātām ।dadarśa tanvīm manasābhijātām ॥5-5-23॥

translations.english: Hanuman could not find Sita anywhere, an excellent lady born in a noble royal family, adopting the right path, a lady delicate like a blossoming creeper of good breed, or so he imagined.

verses.sloka: सनातने वर्त्मानि सम्निविष्टाम् ।रामेक्षणां तां मदनाभिविष्टाम् ।भर्तुर्मनः श्रीमदनुप्रविष्टाम् ।स्त्रीभ्यो वराभ्यश्च सदा विशिष्टाम् ॥५-५-२४॥
verses.transliteration: sanātane vartmāni samniviṣṭām ।rāmekṣaṇāṁ tāṁ madanābhiviṣṭām ।bharturmanaḥ śrīmadanupraviṣṭām ।strībhyo varābhyaśca sadā viśiṣṭām ॥5-5-24॥

translations.english: 'Sita must have had a pair of beautiful eyes. She must have been a passionate lady with mind fixed on her glorious husband. Ever established in dharma, she is perhaps a distinguished lady compared to her counterparts (in Lanka).

verses.sloka: उष्णार्दिताम् सानुसृतास्रकण्ठीम् ।पुरा वरार्होत्तमनिष्ककण्ठीम् ।सुजातपक्ष्मामभिरक्तकण्ठीम् ।वनेऽप्रनृत्तामिव नीलकण्ठीम् ॥५-५-२५॥
verses.transliteration: uṣṇārditām sānusṛtāsrakaṇṭhīm ।purā varārhottamaniṣkakaṇṭhīm ।sujātapakṣmāmabhiraktakaṇṭhīm ।vane'pranṛttāmiva nīlakaṇṭhīm ॥5-5-25॥

translations.english: She whose neck was adorned with costly ornaments earlier must be shedding hot tears now, her throat choked with grief. With her beautiful eyelashes and a sweet loving voice, she would be now like a peahen wandering in the woods.

verses.sloka: अव्यक्तरेखामिव चन्द्ररेखां ।पाम्सुप्रदिग्धामिव हेमरेखाम् ।क्षतप्ररूढामिव बाणरेखां ।वायुप्रभिन्नामिव मेघरेक्षाम् ॥५-५-२६॥
verses.transliteration: avyaktarekhāmiva candrarekhāṁ ।pāmsupradigdhāmiva hemarekhām ।kṣataprarūḍhāmiva bāṇarekhāṁ ।vāyuprabhinnāmiva megharekṣām ॥5-5-26॥

translations.english: She would be like a barely visible ray of the Moon, like a streak of gold covered with dust, like an unhealed scar of a wound caused by an arrow only superficially covered and like a flake of cloud swept off by the wind.
translations.hindi: रज धूसरित जिमि हेमरेखा ससिकला धूमिले भई । छत बान के श्रावात को घन-अवलि वायु बिखरि गई

verses.sloka: सीतामपश्यन् मनुजेश्वरस्य ।रामस्य पत्नीम् वदताम् वरस्य ।बभूव दुःखाभिहतश्चिरस्य ।प्लवङ्गमो मन्द इवाचिरस्य ॥५-५-२७॥
verses.transliteration: sītāmapaśyan manujeśvarasya ।rāmasya patnīm vadatām varasya ।babhūva duḥkhābhihataścirasya ।plavaṅgamo manda ivācirasya ॥5-5-27॥

translations.english: Hanuman stood griefstricken, having (unsuccessfully) searched for a long time for the wife of Rama, the lord of men. The highly eloquent was now despondent. For a while he looked dull and dejected. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
